method: Bounded unauthenticated first-party HTTP captures through headless Chromium after MCP profile-in-use failure. Eight exact profile URLs generated by the site native state/city dropdown handlers; no application form opened/submitted.
sanitization: Anonymous CSRF meta/input token values and CSP nonce attributes redacted. No applicant data, cookies or credentials.
scope: Eight currently visible first-party profiles, workplace-state column and exact branch schemas. No independent employer-wide native total; do not certify whole-company inventory or zero.
dates: No job publication timestamps supplied. Branch created/modified values remain branch metadata and must never be used as job publication dates.
